label: ε, x̂₀ and v are interchangeable

spec.title: Converting between prediction targets
spec.caption: General Gaussian path x_t = α_t x₀ + σ_t ε; rectified flow is α_t = 1 − t, σ_t = t.

steps.explanation: From a noise prediction (DDPM, Stable Diffusion 1 and XL) to a data prediction.
And back. Which target is easiest to learn depends on σ: ε is trivial at high noise, x₀ at low noise.

steps.latex: x_t = (1 - t)\, x_0 + t\, \varepsilon \;\Rightarrow\; v = \frac{\mathrm d x_t}{\mathrm d t} = \varepsilon - x_0
steps.explanation: On the straight rectified-flow path the velocity is constant along each pair (x₀, ε). SD3 and FLUX predict v.

steps.latex: \hat x_0 = x_t - t\, \hat v, \qquad \hat\varepsilon = x_t + (1 - t)\, \hat v
steps.explanation: So a velocity model is also a denoiser: every architecture in the gallery answers the same question.
